title: Cancelled, Dysfunctional & Definitely Watching
description: A sharp adult game covering cancelled internet stars, The Pitt on Max, classic sci-fi, Adventures in Odyssey, TV's most toxic family dynamics, and beloved after-school cartoons.

questions.question: With over 20 million subscribers, this creator left YouTube permanently in June 2020 after resurfaced old content sparked widespread backlash.
This YouTube star sparked international outrage in January 2018 after posting footage filmed in Japan's Aokigahara forest.
This creator stepped back from YouTube in 2020 after decade-old offensive content resurfaced — he was known for celebrity palette collabs and sprawling documentary series.
Swedish gamer Felix Kjellberg lost his Disney-backed premium YouTube show in 2017 after a Wall Street Journal investigation highlighted anti-Semitic imagery in his videos.
This British creator's 2014 video of grabbing women on the street became one of YouTube's first major harassment controversies and effectively ended his career.
The Pitt's lead actor is familiar to medical drama fans — he spent a decade playing Dr. John Carter on NBC's ER.
The Pitt premiered in January 2025 on this Warner Bros. Discovery streaming platform.
Each of The Pitt's fifteen episodes represents exactly this duration of real time, meaning an entire season covers one continuous ER shift.
Critics compared The Pitt's episode-per-hour format to this earlier real-time drama starring Kiefer Sutherland as counter-terrorism agent Jack Bauer.
The Pitt shares an executive producer with both ER and The West Wing — this veteran television showrunner has been making prestige dramas for decades.
Douglas Adams's supercomputer Deep Thought spends 7.5 million years calculating this as the Answer to the Ultimate Question of Life, the Universe, and Everything.
In Blade Runner, investigators administer this empathy-measuring interrogation to determine whether a subject is human or an artificial replicant.
Charlton Heston's 1973 sci-fi film culminates in the horrifying revelation that a future society's miracle food product is manufactured from human corpses.
James S.A. Corey's novel series — adapted for Amazon Prime — follows humanity's fractured solar system as it grapples with a mysterious alien substance called the protomolecule.
In this 1961 Stanisław Lem novel, scientists aboard a station orbiting a sentient ocean planet are confronted by perfect physical recreations of people from their pasts.
Every kid in the town of Odyssey congregates at this ice cream parlor and discovery emporium owned by John Avery Whittaker.
This beloved inventor and soda fountain proprietor of Adventures in Odyssey is known to every kid in the town of Odyssey by a single syllable.
Whit's most celebrated invention places children inside immersive historical and biblical scenarios experienced entirely within their own minds.
This hyper-verbose, socially awkward genius worked at Whit's End and made a long journey from skepticism to Christian faith across Adventures in Odyssey's run.
Adventures in Odyssey is produced by this Colorado Springs-based Christian ministry, founded by psychologist James Dobson in 1977.
questions.answer: What is Focus on the Family?

categories.name: HOME IS WHERE THE HURT IS

questions.question: Logan Roy kept his four children locked in a permanent rivalry for control of his media empire across four seasons of this acclaimed HBO drama.
The Gallagher children of Chicago's South Side raised themselves for eleven seasons while their father — played by William H. Macy — chased alcohol and get-rich-quick schemes.
Gene Hackman plays a deadbeat patriarch who fakes terminal illness to win back his estranged family of failed child prodigies in this 2001 Wes Anderson film.
Tracy Letts's Pulitzer-winning play — adapted into a 2013 film starring Meryl Streep — centers on a pill-addicted Oklahoma mother whose husband's disappearance forces her toxic family back together.
In this 1979 V.C. Andrews gothic novel, four siblings are locked in a grandmother's attic for years while their mother pursues an inheritance — and the eldest two develop a forbidden bond.
questions.answer: What is Flowers in the Attic?

questions.question: This Nickelodeon animated series followed a kid with a football-shaped head and his lovable grandparents through life in the fictional city of Hillwood.
Arthur and his friends at Lakewood Elementary dread the rigorous homework assignments handed out by this bespectacled third-grade teacher on the PBS animated series.
T.J. Detweiler and five friends navigate a grade-school playground ruled by a self-declared monarch named King Bob in this late-'90s Disney animated series.
First on Nickelodeon then Disney, this '90s cartoon followed a journal-writing boy, his crush Patti Mayonnaise, and his blue-skinned best friend Skeeter Valentine.
In this Nickelodeon series, a thoughtful middle schooler navigated the social divide between her scrappy friend group and the popular crowd led by wealthy Courtney Gripling.
questions.answer: What is As Told by Ginger?
